title: Warcraft III: Reforged
notes: Warcraft III has Blizzard's anti-cheat, so Vault never reads its memory. Achievements come from the campaign progress file the game saves in Documents\Warcraft III when you beat a chapter.
Achievements pop on the victory screen, as soon as the game saves your progress. Progress you already have counts too.
Campaign on Hard: set the difficulty to Hard before you play the chapter. Chapters you beat before Vault was watching do not count as Hard.
Skirmish and lifetime achievements come from the replay Warcraft III saves after every game (LastReplay.w3g). Turning on "Auto-save replays" in Options keeps every game, so none are missed.
Orc prologue achievements by Electronic-Fold-5138 (more of his list will follow as their place in the saves is found).

testGuide.title: Beat a campaign chapter
testGuide.detail: Play any chapter to the victory screen. The chapter counts below go up when the game saves.

testGuide.title: Look for the popup
testGuide.detail: The achievement for that chapter should pop within a couple of seconds.
